title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Aisha Khan
description:
Motivation: Automate TLS/certificate rotation and KMS/HSM key lifecycle for Private Installer (VPC/on-prem) deployments to reduce manual ops and eliminate downtime during key rotation. This PR adds a coordinated rotation path integrating Vault (optional), kubernetes-sops/sealed-secrets, Helm chart hooks, and Terraform modules for key material provisioning.

What this PR does: 
- New Terraform module: infra/terraform/modules/kms-rotation that provisions KMS aliases, schedules key rotation windows, and outputs integration bindings for Vault and our private-installer. Supports cloud KMS and HSM-backed KMS (via external key provider).
- Helm chart changes: private-installer/templates/_helpers.tpl and charts/private-installer values.schema.json additions. New values.privateInstaller.certRotation config drives automated cert/key rollovers, grace periods, and rollout window. Adds pre-upgrade/post-upgrade hooks to perform safe key swaps.
- Sealed-secrets/Vault integration: optional path values.security.enableSealedSecrets=true wires the sealed-secrets controller to re-seal rotated keys using customer KMS. When enabled, rotation controller will create a transitional secret (old/new) and update deployments with Kubernetes rollout strategy to avoid restarts outside maintenance windows. Additionally, we added a vault-sync job to bootstrap Vault with the rotated key material when Vault is used as the source of truth.
- HSM/KMS support: rotation controller supports both cloud KMS APIs and HSM-backed KMIP providers via a pluggable connector. We added a new connector implementation and a lightweight test shim for local integration tests.
- Upgrade/rollback tooling: migration job and rollback strategy implemented as a Helm chart job. The job can be executed as a one-off via helm hook or as part of the operator flow. Rollback path preserves previous secrets for a configurable retention window and records operations in audit logs.
- Tests and observability: integration tests in perf-canary/rotation-e2e added, metrics (rotation_duration_seconds, rotation_failures_total) and tracing span points added to the controller. Documentation updates in redwood-private-installer/README.md and a runbook in ops/runbooks/tls-rotation.md.

Checklist: 
- [x] Terraform module + docs 
- [x] Helm chart values + hooks 
- [x] Sealed-secrets and Vault integration 
- [x] HSM connector and tests 
- [x] Rollback/migration job and runbook 
- [x] CI integration and e2e tests

Notes on rollout: We made the new rotation controller opt-in via values.privateInstaller.certRotation.enabled (default false). Customers upgrading to the new chart will not have rotation enabled by default. When enabling during an upgrade, users must provide either kms.provider (cloud) or hsm.connector config. See README for migration steps.

Related: ENG-4567 (design doc), ENG-4602 (operator integration), SUP-9821 (customer incident that motivated safe rekey flow).
